name: Ioun Stone (Protection)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

text: An Ioun Stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. While attuned to it, you can toss the stone into the air as a Magic action; it then orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet and confers its benefit on you. You can seize the orbiting stone as an action to take it back. This protection stone: +1 Armor Class.
